title: Really nice placemats!
text: Really nice placemats!. These are super attractive placemats. I love the color (blue) as they match my kitchen decor perfectly. They wipe clean easily and I usually use an extra one to put my hotter serving dishes on. Highly recommend these if you are in the market for new placemats.

product_metadata.title: Dailinece Placemats for Table Place Mat Dining Kitchen Washable Heat Resistant Woven Vinyl Non-Slip PVC Set of 4 (Gold)
features: 【DESIGN】Our woven vinyl-polyester placemat adds style to indoor or outdoor dining. When mealtime is over, our placemat cleans up easily with just the wipe of a damp cloth and a quick air dry. Dailinece placemats packaged flat, rolls up nicely for easy storage, rolls out flat for use. The Dimension of the placemat is 18"X 12"(45cmX30cm).

【HIGH QUALITY】Economic PVC materials are used for the placemats (70% Terrastrand PVC and 30% polyester). Dailinece placemats are heat resistant, effective to approximately 176 F(80C), harmless to the human body.

【EASY TO CLEAN】Just cleanse in warm soapy water and wipe dry; If stains are stuck in the placemats, please scrub with plastic brush; Non fading. Do not use stainless scoring pads, dishwasher, bleach, iron or dry clean
【WIDE APPLICATION】Modern stylish placemats for most dining tables, patio tables, coffee tables, perfect for daily use.

【NO RISK PURCHASE】Our customer service team is here for you. Please contact us if you have any concern or feedback. And we will get back to you within two business days. We value our relationship with our customers. Our ultimate goal is your satisfaction.
